regime_notes: No new ecosystem crossed the framework threshold since the 08:26 UTC tokenized-equity utilization alert. Broad DEX activity is not showing a clean new cross-chain migration burst, and current chain-specific gains are mixed rather than synchronized.

Lighter/LIT was investigated as a fresh momentum candidate after a roughly mid-teens 24h price gain and an Arc integration catalyst. The signal is rejected for now: the reported three accumulation wallets are described as moving in sync rather than independently; rising price alongside declining open interest is consistent with short covering; and the live Robinhood-Lighter campaign awards points/LIT based on trading volume, with fee-free trading and wallet multipliers, materially contaminating volume/user-growth evidence.

LIT protocol economics are not dismissed: Lighter has substantial perp volume and reported protocol revenue/buyback activity, and the Ethereum token contract appears verified with standard ERC20/ERC2612 surface. However, only about 25% of supply is circulating and large team/investor/ecosystem allocations remain locked, so dilution plus incentive contamination prevent a paper entry without independent selective-wallet and post-incentive persistence confirmation.

RAY remains the strongest Solana application-layer watch for tokenized-equity utilization, but no fresh independently funded selective-wallet cohort was verified this run. DRV remains a high-momentum options-market candidate, but its prior supply/governance and wallet-quality caveats remain unresolved. Neither qualifies for a prospective paper buy at current momentum levels.

Robinhood Chain continues to show strong DEX/perp activity and tokenized-equity composability, but the current Lighter reward campaign means a material part of observed incremental perps/user activity cannot be classified as clean discretionary speculation. Arc remains a real speculative launch regime but its launchpad/reward contamination and structurally rejected token leaders remain unchanged.

ZEC remains above the blended paper basis and near the position cap, but no fourth independently verified selective accumulator surfaced in this scan. HYPE's Payward/HIP-3 distribution catalyst remains meaningful but still awaits regulatory approval/live volume. UNI and AERO did not develop a material thesis or structural change.

Marked paper NAV is approximately $9,864.45 versus $9,768.52 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by $95.93 or about 98.2 bp. No current holding triggered a hard structural failure, thesis invalidation, trim or exit condition.
